Question
========
Explain the following concept, spelling out the acronym first if there is one. Give its definition and its usage, and if it has several usages, its most important one.

**ALU**

Solution
========
Arithmetic Logic Unit. The functional unit that performs the arithmetic and logic operations of the CPU. Having several of them is what allows a superscalar CPU to execute several instructions in the same cycle.
